[NDBG.7.1] These accessors favour "empty, not error": unsupported backend or
unknown id yields `DS_OK` with no results. `DS_ERR_INVAL` is returned for NULL
engine / required out-pointers, and for a NULL required callback:
`ds_engine_rete_network`'s `node_cb`, and the callback of
`ds_engine_rete_match_trace` and `ds_engine_refracted_activations`.
`edge_cb` is optional ([NDBG.4.1]). `DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` for an out-of-range index or an
unmapped `node_id` (`ds_engine_line_span_find`); `DS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` from
`ds_engine_mem` on a non-Rete engine. See [NERR].
